prompt: High-angle view at 65° of a generous four-portion salad on a large white ceramic platter, serving spoon resting in the food. Dark green curly kale with a muted olive-grey cast, softened but still curly and ruffled, in irregular stem-free leaves, lightly coated with a pale ivory, thin creamy dressing with tiny mustard specks. Mix in bright orange, crisp raw carrot matchsticks and sparse fresh deep-green coriander flecks. Arrange glistening coral-pink, membrane-free grapefruit crescents with juicy vesicles, elongated golden-brown toasted pecan halves with darker ridged patches, and glossy ruby-red, juicy pomegranate arils visibly on top. Cool freshly dressed salad, no steam. Food fills most of the square frame, platter edge cropped; warm light wood background, narrow linen napkin edge. Bright soft natural daylight, crisp detail, true-to-life colours, magazine cover food photography. No extra garnish, props, text, logos, hands or people.

visible_ingredients.real_life_appearance: Blanched for 1-2 minutes, chilled and drained: dark green curly kale with a muted olive-grey cast, softened but still curly and ruffled, pliable and tender-crisp rather than raw-crisp or fully braised, with a moist sheen. Irregular stem-free leaves, roughly 5-10 cm, about 4-6 leaves per portion. Deeply frilled leaves distinguish it from smooth, pale cabbage.

Raw, peeled and finely cut: bright orange, crisp raw carrot matchsticks with smooth cut surfaces, about 4-5 cm long and 0.2-0.3 cm wide, roughly 25-35 visible strips per portion, lightly glossy where dressing adheres. Clearly fine strips, not grated carrot or softened cooked batons.

Raw, deeply peeled and filleted with all white pith and dividing membranes removed: glistening coral-pink, membrane-free grapefruit crescents with juicy vesicles, tender, juicy, tapered and slightly irregular, 3-5 cm long, 2-3 pieces per portion. Larger and paler pink than orange segments, with no white membrane edges.

Briefly dry-toasted and cooled: elongated golden-brown toasted pecan halves with darker ridged patches, dry, crisp and slightly wrinkled with lengthwise grooves, about 2-3 cm each, 3-4 halves per portion. Slimmer, longer and less convoluted than walnut halves; not uniformly browned or oily.

Raw arils: glossy ruby-red, juicy pomegranate arils, translucent, some deep wine-red, plump irregular angular ovals about 0.5-0.8 cm, approximately 35-45 arils per portion. These are juicy seed sacs, not dry red spice seeds or smooth spherical currants.

Raw and roughly chopped: sparse fresh deep-green coriander flecks, delicate flat leaf fragments and fine stem pieces, 0.5-1.5 cm, about 1 teaspoon per portion. Where identifiable, the rounded lobes distinguish it from pointed flat-leaf parsley; used only sparingly.

Emulsified and loosened with grapefruit juice: a pale ivory, thin creamy dressing with tiny mustard specks and a light oily sheen. It fluidly coats the leaves and carrot strips, with a little collecting at the platter base, rather than forming a thick mayonnaise-like layer.
